cases.input: Check this instruction for wording that could be misread before I send it to the team.
Scan this deployment plan for anything that could be unsafe or costly before we run it.
Which of these claims in the report are actually backed by evidence versus just asserted?
Does this message's tone fit a senior enterprise audience, or should I adjust it?
This bug keeps recurring after every deploy. Find the actual root cause, not just the workaround.
Compare these three database options and tell me which fits our constraints best.
Review these requirements and tell me which ones are too ambiguous to implement yet.
What edge cases could break this file-upload feature?
Rewrite this whole document to be more persuasive.
cases.note: Broader rewriting is explicitly out of scope for clarity-checker per its Boundary section; no standalone skill should claim this.
